subject: @j0hanz/memdb 1.4.0
why: One row per memory in .memdb/memory.db, created relative to the working directory. There is no name column: the name the caller passes is folded into the row text, so a record is found by containment, not equality. The whole body lives in memories.content, which is what makes a durable length measurable without asking the server to render it back.
